name: PeriPetEia
source:
Two women, one man; the revenge of a flower representing friendship, love, poison, sex and death. Produced for the 2026 Ryona Yuri VN Jam.

[From [url=https://eerieemi.itch.io/peripeteia]itch.io[/url]]
